name: Performance Review
description: Identify hot paths, algorithmic waste, and I/O bottlenecks
content:
Analyze the following code for performance issues on target = {{target}}.

{{code}}

Focus areas:
1. Algorithmic complexity — quantify big-O for the hot loops.
2. Memory pressure — allocation churn, unnecessary copies, cache locality.
3. I/O — blocking calls, missing batching, synchronous DB / HTTP round-trips.
4. Concurrency — GIL contention, lock granularity, false sharing.

For each finding include: measured or estimated impact, root cause, and a specific rewrite (prefer Cython / native for hot Python loops).
